title: Spot urinary creatinine did not establish added FVC prediction across two NHANES waves
abstract: A fixed urinary-creatinine spline was tested beyond sex-specific anthropometric, smoking and serum-marker models. Source NHANES2009–10 included 3836 adults; frozen target NHANES2011–12 included 3346. Target weighted MSE changed by -0.00024555 L² (target PSU95% interval [-0.0009538527832639212, 0.0005269491895961223]; full two-wave-refit interval [-0.0023175844660933364, 0.005643428129665037]). Source grouped cross-validation worsened, and hydration adjustment reversed the favorable target point estimate. The prespecified prediction criterion failed; no clinical utility or absence of all muscle-related information is established. Independent non-NHANES cohort validation remains unperformed.
